description: Unisys ePortal provides behavioral enrichment for IBM CardDemo transactions. IBM already holds all financial amounts including shopping — Unisys adds context like merchant details, loyalty, browsing behavior.

entities.relationship: Many shopping records enrich IBM transaction records with behavioral context
entities.spend_note: IBM transactionAmount already includes shopping spend. Unisys amount mirrors it — do NOT sum both for total spend.

entities.relationship: Inventory records provide product availability context for merchants and categories observed in shopping behavior
